open_questions.gap: The 35% app-booking target is relayed second-hand by Sofia from the kickoff; the thread does not say whether it is 35% of early booking reservations only or of all reservations, over what period, or who Άρης is.
open_questions.why_it_matters: A KPI with an unclear base and period cannot be measured or reported against.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Για το 35% που αναφέρατε: αφορά το 35% των κρατήσεων early booking ή του συνόλου των κρατήσεων, και για ποια περίοδο; Μπορείτε επίσης να μας επιβεβαιώσετε τον ρόλο του Άρη ως αποφασίζοντα για τον στόχο;

open_questions.gap: The forwarded Harbourline note gives an average paid-social cost per booking of €4,10 for the 2026 season. It is past-agency context, not a 2027 commitment, and it is unclear whether it should serve as a planning benchmark.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Using a past-season cost per booking as a benchmark without confirmation could distort channel mix and budget expectations.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Το μέσο κόστος ανά κράτηση από paid social των €4,10 της Harbourline θέλετε να το χρησιμοποιήσουμε ως βάση σύγκρισης για το 2027;

open_questions.gap: No 2027 budget figure, range or constraint is stated anywhere in this thread.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Scope and channel mix cannot be sized without knowing the budget and whether media spend and production are separate.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιο είναι το budget για την καμπάνια του 2027, και ποιο μέρος αφορά media spend και ποιο παραγωγή;

open_questions.gap: The language of the materials for Germany and Italy is still undecided; Pavlos says it is being discussed internally (2026-09-16) and Eleni is still waiting (2026-09-17).
open_questions.why_it_matters: The language decision determines how many versions of each asset are needed and drives production cost and timing.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Μπορείτε να μας πείτε σε ποια γλώσσα θα είναι τα υλικά για Γερμανία και Ιταλία και πότε αναμένεται η απόφαση;

open_questions.gap: The new Levanta Club perks are not yet available (Sofia, 2026-09-11: nothing yet) and no later message provides them.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The perks are likely a core message for the early booking offer, and creative cannot be finalised without them.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Πότε αναμένετε να κλειδώσουν τα νέα προνόμια του Levanta Club και ποιος θα μας τα στείλει;

open_questions.gap: A release date for the new app was requested on 2026-09-09 and has not been given in any later message.
open_questions.why_it_matters: App-based booking goals and app-channel activity depend on when the app is available.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποια είναι η ημερομηνία κυκλοφορίας του νέου app;

open_questions.gap: The person who gives final creative approval has not been named. Sofia says 'το κρατάει ο Παύλος' but does not confirm whether Pavlos is himself the approver, and Eleni is still waiting for a name.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a named approver the approval step can stall and delay the campaign.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιος είναι το πρόσωπο που δίνει το τελικό approval του δημιουργικού; Είναι ο Παύλος ή κάποιος άλλος;
